messages:
hannah (PM): short sync: decide core scope for Optimize Advisor pilot (recommendations + eval alerts). keep it minimal.
dmitri (Eng): agree. ship: batching/caching recs + eval-triggered alerting. defer auto-apply and advanced quant flows.
luna (ML): need signals: est_token_savings, eval_delta_pct, p95_latency_delta. also confidence for quant recs.
jo (Design): admin needs a compact card: reason, sample diff, cost delta, accept/reject. one-click revert.
nate (SRE): rollout rules: hosted route-level ramp; dedicated node canaries (10%). circuit-breaker if p95 > SLO for 10m.
ops-bot: created ticket OPT-2026 assigned to hannah, dmitri, luna, nate. checklist: pilot matrix, eval harness, canary runbook, admin mock.
hannah (PM): draft gates: 1) >=2 pilots run and confirm >=6% token savings; 2) no critical eval regression >2%; 3) p95 latency regression <=25ms; 4) alerts wired to #prod-evals + customer webhook. feedback?
luna (ML): tighten gate 2 for regulated customers: regression <=1% on critical prompts. also require nightly eval diffs stored.
dmitri (Eng): add per-route "latency-first" profile to disable batching. implement as dynamic config.
jo (Design): will post 2 compact mocks by EOD showing card + diff preview.
hannah (PM): next steps: dmitri pilot matrix template, luna eval harness, nate canary steps, jo mocks. sync Fri 09:00 PT to sign off. If blocked, post here. :rocket:
